**Supplementary Table S3.** Detection of injected problems by the readiness checks in the 2017–2019 cohort. Each problem was injected into a random 1%, 10% or 50% of the records it applies to; a record counts as detected when the check for that problem flags it. Recall is detected injected records over injected records; precision is detected injected records over all flagged records. For glucose units, the 211,894 results that already failed the check after mapping (bedside results without a unit) are flagged at every rate and lower precision; every injected result was still found.
